description: This file defines an interface for reading calendar data within the Fineract platform. It includes method declarations for retrieving, generating, and updating calendar-related information, as well as checking entity associations.

classes.name: CalendarReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface specifying methods for reading and managing calendar data within the financial platform.

methods.name: retrieveCalendar
methods.description: Fetches a specific calendar based on provided identifiers.

methods.name: retrieveCalendarsByEntity
methods.description: Retrieves all calendars associated with a particular entity and calendar type options.

methods.name: retrieveParentCalendarsByEntity
methods.description: Fetches parent calendars linked to a specified entity.

methods.name: retrieveNewCalendarDetails
methods.description: Provides details necessary for creating a new calendar.

methods.name: generateRecurringDates
methods.description: Generates recurring dates based on calendar data, with options to include historical dates and specify an end date.

methods.name: generateNextTenRecurringDates
methods.description: Creates the next ten recurring dates for a given calendar.

methods.name: updateWithRecurringDates
methods.description: Updates a collection of calendar data with their respective recurring dates.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCalendar
methods.description: Retrieves the calendar associated with a specific loan.

methods.name: retrieveCollctionCalendarByEntity
methods.description: Fetches the collection calendar linked to a specific entity.

methods.name: generateNextEligibleMeetingDateForCollection
methods.description: Calculates the next suitable meeting date for a collection based on calendar and last meeting info.

methods.name: isCalendarAssociatedWithEntity
methods.description: Checks whether a given calendar is associated with a specified entity.
